BASE='https://maas-coding-api.cn-huabei-1.xf-yun.com'
MODEL='xopglm52'

echo '=== 1) DNS / TLS / base reachability ==='
for path in / /v2 /anthropic /v1/responses /v1/models /v2/models; do
  echo "--- GET $path ---"
  curl -sS -o /tmp/xf_body.txt -w 'http=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s size=%{size_download}\n' \
    --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 20 \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
    -H "api-key: $API_KEY" \
    "$BASE$path" || echo "curl_error=$?"
  head -c 400 /tmp/xf_body.txt; echo; echo
done

for url in \
  "$BASE/v2/chat/completions" \
  "$BASE/v1/chat/completions" \

  "$BASE/v2/v1/chat/completions"

    -d "{\"model\":\"$MODEL\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"ping\"}],\"max_tokens\":16,\"stream\":false}" \
    "$url" || echo "curl_error=$?"

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
